---
title: "Processing ILT Control Files"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
Folder <- "Ctrl_Antibody"
StorageLocation <- file.path("data", Folder)

OutputLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder)
if (!dir.exists(OutputLocation)){dir.create(OutputLocation)}
```

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation,
 pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)

MyCytoSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files[1:3],
 truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)

MyGatingSet <- GatingSet(MyCytoSet)
```

```{r}
pData(MyGatingSet)
```

```{r}
markernames(MyGatingSet[1])
```
